components.name: SIEM Panel (Interactive)
components.description: Tactical glassmorphic panel with neon glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-siem-panel-interactive { background: rgba(29, 29, 29, 0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid #333333; color: #E2E8F0; padding: 16px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-siem-panel-interactive:hover { border-color: rgba(229, 189, 223, 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(229, 189, 223, 0.15); }

narrative.overview: A hyper-focused, tactical command center with high-contrast data visualization. The interface prioritizes immediate data legibility over unnecessary decorations. It strictly adheres to a dark, tactical aesthetic that feels solid and secure.

rules.name: The Tactical Contrast Rule
rules.body: Color is reserved for meaning. Large surfaces remain completely neutral; the Orchid accent is used sparingly to draw the eye to interactive or changing data.

rules.name: The Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Any changing numerical data, logs, or IDs must use the monospace font for tabular alignment and immediate tactical scanning.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus) in the form of neon glows.

dos: Do use IBM Plex Mono for all changing metrics, IDs, and logs.
Do apply the Orchid accent strictly to interactive or high-priority states.
donts: Don't use heavy drop shadows for structural depth.
Don't use border radiuses on tactical panels.
